subject: Vendor onboarding: PO requirements & invoice cadence (Medialink)
messages:
From: Alyssa D'Angelo <alyssa@medialink.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@medialink.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO requirements & invoice cadence

Hi Lukas / Vanessa,

We're finalizing vendor onboarding for Q4 and have a couple of procurement constraints to confirm before we issue a PO to Redwood:

- PO format: Our AP team requires a PO that includes a project code (GL-4A), netted line items per SOW, and a billing contact. Can you confirm what fields we need present on the PO for Redwood to accept and map to invoices?
- Net terms: Medialink standard is Net45 for third-party SaaS vendors. This needs to be contractual and visible on the invoice. Are you able to accept Net45?
- Invoice cadence: We prefer a monthly invoice with consolidated line items per PO; alternatively, we can accept quarterly invoices if there's a prepay/discount. Please confirm how Redwood prefers to bill (monthly vs quarterly) and whether any discount applies for prepay.
- PO references: AP requires the PO number to appear in the invoice header and in the remittance advice.

I've attached our standard PO template for reference (see attachment). If you can send a short template of the invoice header fields you need and any restrictions on line-item granularity, we can circulate internally and aim to issue the PO next week.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa D'Angelo
Senior Procurement Manager, Medialink
procurement@medialink.com
[Attachment: Medialink_PO_Template.pdf]

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa D'Angelo <alyssa@medialink.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO requirements & invoice cadence

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the details and template. Quick answers and next steps below.

- PO fields: We require PO number, vendor remit-to address, billing entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.), tax ID (EIN), and a short description line that ties back to the SOW/quote number. We can accept the project code in a separate PO line and map it to GL-4A on our side.
- Net terms: Our standard is Net30. For enterprise clients with approved credit checks/POs we can extend to Net45 on a case-by-case basis. To do Net45 we need the PO referenced in the contract amendment (or SOW) and an AR contact for Medialink.
- Invoice cadence and discounts: We support monthly invoices by default. We can offer a 4% discount for quarterly prepayment, or 5% if the customer pre-pays annually. No discount for standard monthly billing.
- PO references: We will include the PO number in the invoice header and the remittance section — that's standard. Please confirm whether your AP system needs a specific PDF naming convention for ingestion.

I've attached the SOW and a sample invoice header CSV that shows how we map PO fields to our billing system.

Next steps:
1) If Net45 is required, can Medialink add the Net45 amendment clause into the SOW or send an email authorization from your finance lead?
2) Share expected cadence (monthly vs quarterly prepay) so we can prepare invoice templates.
3) Please provide the AP contact (name + email + remit preferences).

I'll follow up Monday to loop in Finance for the credit side if you confirm Net45.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lukas_meyer@redwood.ai
[Attachment: RWI-SOW-2026Q3.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa D'Angelo <alyssa@medialink.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO requirements & invoice cadence

Hi Alyssa — Marissa from Finance here. Quick clarifications from the billing side: 

- PO acceptance: We need the PO number plus the billing entity exactly as in the contract (Redwood Inference, Inc.). If Medialink requires Net45, Finance will require a signed PO AND a signed SOW amendment that references Net45 terms. The amendment can be a short email thread referencing the SOW number—no need for a full contract re-sign if your legal is comfortable.
- Invoice split: We can honor consolidated monthly invoices with aggregated line items per PO. If you ask for per-project (very granular) lines we will require line-item IDs that map to your GL code to avoid manual reconciliation.
- Discounts & prepay: Confirming Lukas — quarterly prepay = 4% off invoice total, annual prepay = 5%. We can only apply discounts at invoice issuance when payment method is confirmed.
- Invoice file requirements: For automated ingestion we prefer PDF named like REDWOOD_INV_<PO#>_<YYYYMM>.pdf. If your system needs different formatting, please send a sample.

I'll provision the Net45 case as a credit exception internally once we receive the PO + SOW amendment and the AR contact.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: invoice_header_sample.csv]

From: Alyssa D'Angelo <alyssa@medialink.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@medialink.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO requirements & invoice cadence

Thanks — all makes sense. A couple quick confirmations so we can move to PO issuance: 

- We'll issue a PO with GL-4A in the line item and include the PO number and project code in the header exactly as you specified.
- Medialink confirms Net45 as the required term. I'll attach a short email from our Finance Director authorizing Net45 and reference the SOW number so no additional redlines are needed.
- For billing cadence: we'll take monthly consolidated invoices to keep our cashflow forecast stable (no prepay). Please proceed with the standard monthly template and include the PDF naming convention you requested — we'll mirror REDWOOD_INV_<PO#>_<YYYYMM>.pdf.

Attaching: Medialink PO template and authorization note from Finance Director. Expect the PO number by end of day Wednesday.

Cheers,
Alyssa
[Attachment: Medialink_PO_Format_Reqs.pdf, Authorization_Net45.txt]
